title: Akɔnnɔ a Ɛwɔ Pia Kronkron no Mu
intro: Wode anammɔn kɔ kronkronbea a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn no mu na wohu Allah akoa bi a ɔde ne ho ama sɛ ogyina hɔ wɔ mpaebɔ mu. Wɔn nsa so, wɔn ani so, na wɔn koma kura akɔnnɔ a akɔ so wɔ wɔn nkwa nna nyinaa mu. Hena ne saa ɔkra a ɔwɔ boasetɔ yi a ne ho a ɔde to Allah so no anhinhim da?
clues: Midii mfe pii wɔ ɔsom ne mpaebɔ mu, na mihuu anwonwade ahorow a ɛhyɛɛ me gyidi den.
Wɔmaa me asɛdeɛ sɛ menhwɛ ɔkra kumaa a wɔahyira no wɔ kronkronbea hɔ.
Bere a merenyin no, m’awerɛhow kɛse ne sɛ na minni ba, efisɛ na me yere yɛ obonin na na yɛn baanu nyinaa anyin.
Mebɔɔ mpaeɛ kyerɛɛ m’Awurade sɛ menya obi a ɔbɛdi n’ade afiri m’ankasa m’abusua mu, obi a ɔbɛtoa nkɔmhyɛ agyapadeɛ no so.
Berɛ a megyina mpaeɛbɔ dan mu no, abɔfoɔ no frɛɛ me kaa sɛ, ‘Allah ma wo anigyeɛ asɛm’, na ehu ne ehu kaa me.
Wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ mɛnya ɔbabarima a wɔfrɛ no Yahya, edin a wɔmfaa mmaa obiara da, na sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne no, merenkasa nkyerɛ nkurɔfo nnansa.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Obonin ne onyin bere a ɔpɛ ɔdedifo trenee
Wɔtow no gu ogya a ɛredɛw mu
Mpataa kɛse bi a ɔbɛmene no
Ahenni bi a wɔbɛhwere ama otirimɔdenfo bi
Obi a wɔbɛpam no afi ne kurom
trial.answer: Obonin ne onyin bere a ɔpɛ ɔdedifo trenee

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Ɔmaa ɔba trenee na ɔkasae bio wɔ nnansa komm akyi
Nsuyiri sɛee no esiane gyidi a wonni nti
Wɔama no ahenni kɛse ne mframa so tumi
outcome.answer: Ɔmaa ɔba trenee na ɔkasae bio wɔ nnansa komm akyi

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
